goal: Assignment and source-locked lessons in backend/routers/history_learning.py and backend/history_models.py
summary: Implemented classroom lesson assignments with immutable source-locked assessment basis in backend/history_models.py, backend/services/history_learning.py, and backend/routers/history_learning.py. Teachers assign lessons pinned to specific lesson content versions, evaluation rubrics (S1_SPATIAL, S2_TEMPORAL, S3_EVIDENCE, S4_ARGUMENT), and verified primary historical source sets. Enforced strict publication gate rejecting any assignment with unreviewed, disputed, or missing historical claims (HTTP 422 ASSIGNMENT_UNVERIFIED_CLAIMS). Enforced immutable assessment basis invariant: subsequent modifications to master lesson content or version do not alter the pinned assessment basis or student submissions for existing assignments.

invariants_enforced.source_locked_lesson_assignment: Assignments strictly capture and pin the lesson content version, lesson metadata snapshot, evaluation rubric, and primary historical source set at creation time.
invariants_enforced.pinned_assessment_basis_immutability: Subsequent edits or version increments to the master LessonContent record in the database do not mutate the assignment's pinned assessment basis or student submissions (assessment_basis_snapshot).
invariants_enforced.negative_abuse_publication_gate: An assignment cannot be published (via creation or /publish endpoint) if any required historical claim is in ('unreviewed', 'needs_source', 'rejected', 'disputed', 'superseded') or if the lesson is flagged 'blocked_for_authoritative_learning'. Violations fail with HTTP 422 ASSIGNMENT_UNVERIFIED_CLAIMS.
invariants_enforced.rubric_grading_workflow: Submissions are evaluated against the pinned rubric criteria (e.g. S1-S4 historical competencies) with teacher scores, feedback, and timestamping.
invariants_enforced.classroom_scoping_and_rbac: Only teachers of the classroom or admins can create, publish, or grade assignments; only enrolled classroom students can submit responses.

changes.description: Added HistoryLessonAssignment and HistoryAssignmentSubmission domain models with JSONB snapshot columns (pinned_lesson_snapshot, rubric, pinned_source_ids, pinned_sources_snapshot, pinned_claim_ids, assessment_basis_snapshot) and get_assessment_basis helper method.
Exported HistoryLessonAssignment and HistoryAssignmentSubmission from backend.history_models to ensure inclusion in Base.metadata.
Created purely additive Alembic migration creating history_lesson_assignments and history_assignment_submissions tables and foreign key indexes.

Added Pydantic schemas: HistoryLessonAssignmentCreateIn, HistoryLessonAssignmentOut, HistoryLessonAssignmentListOut, HistoryAssignmentAssessmentBasisOut, HistoryLessonAssignmentPublishOut, HistoryAssignmentSubmitIn, HistoryAssignmentSubmissionOut, HistoryAssignmentSubmissionListOut, HistoryAssignmentGradeIn.

Implemented DEFAULT_HISTORICAL_RUBRIC, validate_assignment_for_publication, create_source_locked_assignment, publish_history_assignment, submit_history_assignment, and grade_history_assignment_submission.

Added endpoints: POST /api/v1/history/assignments, GET /api/v1/history/assignments, GET /api/v1/history/assignments/{id}, POST /api/v1/history/assignments/{id}/publish, GET /api/v1/history/assignments/{id}/assessment-basis, POST /api/v1/history/assignments/{id}/submit, GET /api/v1/history/assignments/{id}/submissions, GET /api/v1/history/assignments/{id}/submissions/{sub_id}, POST /api/v1/history/assignments/{id}/submissions/{sub_id}/grade.

Comprehensive integration test suite covering assignment creation with pinned snapshots, negative abuse publication gate rejection against unreviewed/disputed claims, positive publication, pinned assessment basis immutability after master lesson mutation, rubric grading, and access control.

test_details.name: test_teacher_assigns_lesson_with_pinned_version_rubric_and_source_set
test_details.assertion: Verifies teacher can create a classroom lesson assignment with pinned lesson version, frozen lesson snapshot, rubric criteria (S1-S4), and primary source set.

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_assignment_cannot_be_published_if_lesson_has_unverified_claims
test_details.assertion: Negative abuse test: An assignment referencing unreviewed or disputed claims, or a lesson flagged blocked_for_authoritative_learning, is rejected by publication gate with HTTP 422 ASSIGNMENT_UNVERIFIED_CLAIMS.

test_details.name: test_assignment_publication_succeeds_when_all_claims_are_verified
test_details.assertion: Positive test: When all linked claims reach verified status (expert_verified), assignment successfully transitions to published status with published_at timestamp.

test_details.name: test_pinned_assessment_basis_immutable_when_master_lesson_edited_later
test_details.assertion: Invariant verification: Modifying master LessonContent in the database (bumping version, changing text) does not mutate existing assignment or submission assessment basis.

test_details.name: test_submission_and_rubric_grading_workflow
test_details.assertion: Verifies student assignment submission against published assignment and teacher rubric scoring with S1-S4 criteria and feedback.

test_details.name: test_assignment_access_control_and_permissions
test_details.assertion: Verifies RBAC and scoping: learners cannot create assignments, cross-classroom assignment creation is blocked (403), and non-enrolled students cannot submit.
